metadata.description: Primary references for Android testing with Espresso, UI Automator, Compose Testing, screenshot tests, and adaptive UI validation.
metadata.title: QA Testing Android - Sources
metadata.note: Android 17 (API 37) shipped 2026-06-16. Google Play requires target API 36 for new apps/updates as of the 2026-08-31 deadline (existing apps: API 35 minimum), with a one-time extension to 2026-11-01. Re-verify at https://developer.android.com/google/play/requirements/target-sdk before relying on a specific API number.

google_official_docs.description: Android 17 (API level 37) shipped 2026-06-16. Test tooling (Robolectric, Maestro) may lag API-level support by weeks to months after each Android release — verify before assuming coverage.

google_official_docs.name: Google Play Target API Level Requirement
google_official_docs.description: Current target-API deadline: new apps/updates must target API 36 by 2026-08-31 (extension to 2026-11-01 available); existing untouched apps must target at least API 35. This deadline moves roughly yearly — re-check before citing a specific number.

google_official_docs.name: Robolectric
google_official_docs.description: JVM Android unit test framework; 4.16.x supports SDK 36 (requires JDK 21). API 37 (Android 17) support not yet released as of 2026-07-11 (robolectric/robolectric#11239).

modern_tooling.name: Turbine

modern_tooling.name: Maestro
modern_tooling.description: Declarative YAML E2E testing framework for Android, iOS, and web; includes MaestroGPT for LLM-generated flow scaffolding. API 35/36 support added in 2026 (Maestro Cloud lagged local support); API 37 support unverified as of 2026-07-11.
